loop.top3_why_not: Strategy A, while having a slightly better overall score, relies on inverse‑error weighting that can amplify the influence of a few models and is sensitive to the high variance in weight estimation given only three windows. Strategy B’s DBA method shows a large spike in the third window (0.8346), reflecting instability in the DTW barycenter when model rankings shift. Both are therefore less likely to generalize than the simple mean, which is the safest choice under the diagnosis of mixed regime and unstable rankings.
